posts.text: my libra sun and i have been idling on the feeder for forty minutes because the group asked me to pick between pappasito's and ninfa's on navigation, and choosing one would be a public statement against the other
posts.caption: Nobody ate. Everyone felt respected.

posts.text: a libra cannot order at whataburger without first polling the table, then the car, then the person holding table tent number 47, who frankly has strong feelings about spicy ketchup and deserves to be heard
posts.caption: Democracy, served 24 hours a day

posts.text: as a libra venus i planned the perfect first date at the rothko chapel. beautiful, quiet, free. we sat in sacred silence for an hour. i called it intimacy. they called it the longest job interview of their life
posts.caption: Venus picked the venue. Venus did not read the room.

posts.text: put a libra on the judging panel at the rodeo bar-b-que contest and i will taste 250 briskets, tell every team theirs was the most moving, and submit a scorecard that just says 'yes'
posts.caption: The scales are balanced. The brisket is not ranked.

posts.text: my libra rising keeps two phone numbers, one 713 and one 281, so whoever i'm talking to feels like i'm from their side of the beltway. this is not deception. this is venus doing community outreach
posts.caption: Inside the loop, outside the loop, always on your side

posts.text: my libra moon and i rented a pedal boat on mcgovern lake in hermann park and spent the full thirty minutes making sure we were both pedaling exactly equally. we did not move. but it was fair
posts.caption: Thirty minutes, zero distance, perfect balance

posts.text: my scorpio moon does not check the weather app. i simply know which underpasses on shepherd and memorial are about to flood, the same way i know which of my friends is about to lie to me
posts.caption: Pluto has better radar than the news

posts.text: a scorpio does not go to the galleria to shop. a scorpio goes to the galleria to sit by the ice rink, nurse one coffee for four hours and quietly learn everything about everyone
posts.caption: Window shopping, but the windows are people

posts.text: the scorpio in me reads my ez tag statement like a detective reads a crime scene. you said you were at your mom's in pearland all weekend. the hardy toll road would like a word
posts.caption: Every toll is a receipt. Every receipt is evidence.

posts.text: your honor, my client is a scorpio mars. she did not 'refuse to let him merge' on the katy freeway. she simply remembered that he cut her off at that exact exit in 2019, and she has been waiting
posts.caption: The defense rests. The grudge does not.

posts.text: a scorpio at a viet-cajun crawfish spot on bellaire is silent, focused and surrounded by a terrifying pile of shells. we are not antisocial. we are getting to the bottom of something, which is our entire personality
posts.caption: Pluto rules the underworld and the bottom of the bag

posts.text: scorpio is a fixed water sign, which explains why i thrive in houston in august. the air is ninety percent water, nobody can see clearly, and everyone is sweating about something they refuse to talk about
posts.caption: Humidity is just the city keeping secrets

posts.text: my sagittarius sun cannot pass a buc-ee's on i-10 without stopping. not for gas, not for the bathroom. i go in for one brisket sandwich and come out with beaver nuggets, a deer feeder and a plan to move to wyoming
posts.caption: Jupiter expands everything, including the cart

posts.text: as a sagittarius i will tell you everything in houston is twenty minutes away. kemah, twenty minutes. the woodlands, twenty minutes. this is not a lie. it is jupiter, the planet of optimism, doing my directions
posts.caption: Twenty minutes is a feeling, not a distance

posts.text: put a sagittarius at a woodlands covenants meeting and i will be the one who stands up during the mailbox color debate to ask, respectfully, whether any of us are actually happy
posts.caption: Point of order: what is the meaning of life

posts.text: my sagittarius moon booked a spontaneous beach trip to find myself and ended up in galveston, which counts. i stood on the seawall, ate a funnel cake on the pleasure pier and said 'honestly, this is basically europe'
posts.caption: Passport not required. Confidence was.

posts.text: my sagittarius rising will drive to bush intercontinental at 4am for a cheaper flight to anywhere, even though hobby is closer, because the airport with 'intercontinental' in the name simply feels more like destiny
posts.caption: Hobby is for errands. IAH is for prophecy.

posts.text: a sagittarius heard about the rodeo trail rides camping in memorial park and immediately asked where to get a horse. i have never ridden one. i am, however, half horse, which jupiter says counts as experience
posts.caption: The centaur has entered the trail ride group chat

posts.text: a capricorn does not get stuck on the katy freeway. a capricorn studies it for five years, buys a townhouse two exits closer, and leaves at 5:52am, smiling, while you are still looking for your keys
posts.caption: Saturn does not do rush hour

posts.text: the capricorn at space center houston is not here for the rockets. we are reading the mission control org chart, noting who reported to whom, and quietly drafting a ten year plan to run the moon
posts.caption: One small step for man, one quarterly review for the goat

posts.text: every hurricane season my capricorn sun has the water, batteries and canned goods bought by may. when the storm finally shows up on the news and everyone sprints to h-e-b, i simply sit at home and feel correct
posts.caption: Prepared since May. Smug since June.

posts.text: my capricorn saturn deeply admires mattress mack. a man who bets on the astros, hedges the bet, then refunds the whole city is not gambling. that is a capricorn with a microphone and a furniture store
posts.caption: Risk management, but make it local legend

posts.text: the astros do not really do rain delays at daikin park, because someone built a roof over the problem. that is not baseball. that is my capricorn rising, removing weather from the equation and calling it a plan
posts.caption: Saturn would like to thank the roof

posts.text: the i-45 expansion is expected to take about eighteen years, which my capricorn sun respects. that is not a delay. that is a construction project with capricorn energy: slow, expensive and finishing just to prove you wrong
posts.caption: Patience is a freeway

posts.text: an aquarius does not attend the art car parade. an aquarius has been building a car shaped like a giant mood ring in the garage for three years and refuses to explain it to the neighbors
posts.caption: Uranus approved the permit. The HOA did not.

posts.text: as an aquarius i refuse to say feeder road. i say frontage road, out loud, in houston, at full volume, and i will plant my flag on this hill, which to be fair is the only hill houston has
posts.caption: Fixed air, fixed opinion, flat city

posts.text: my aquarius moon respects slab culture deeply, because a candy painted car rolling slow down the block, trunk open, playing a song slowed to half speed is the most unbothered thing humanity has ever invented
posts.caption: Detached, but make it swangin

posts.text: an aquarius friend will ignore your texts for a week, then appear at a 2am pho spot on bellaire with three strangers from a philosophy forum and act like this was always the plan
posts.caption: Unreachable until suddenly very reachable

posts.text: my aquarius placements have a fully drafted, deeply unsolicited plan for the astrodome. it involves an indoor rainforest, a community garden and a co-op. nobody asked. i have emailed the county twice
posts.caption: The Eighth Wonder needs a ninth idea

posts.text: put an aquarius at johnson space center and i will skip the gift shop, find an engineer on break and ask, as a concerned citizen, why we keep going back to the moon when space is right there
posts.caption: Ruled by Uranus, which is technically further

posts.text: my pisces moon went to a free show at miller outdoor theatre, sat on the hill and cried at a children's ballet, a sunset and a stranger offering me bug spray. it was ninety degrees at 9pm and i have never felt more seen
posts.caption: Neptune does not need a ticket

posts.text: pisces is a water sign, which is why when my street in midtown floods after twenty minutes of rain, i do not panic. i stand on the porch, feel at one with it, and text my ex
posts.caption: Mutable water in a city that agrees

posts.text: as a pisces i only listen to music chopped and screwed, because life is already moving way too fast and dj screw was the only one who understood my feelings need to be played at half speed
posts.caption: Slowed down so the feelings can keep up

posts.text: my pisces venus fell in love on buffalo bayou because we watched the bats leave the waugh drive bridge at sunset and he said 'wow.' we are now planning a life together. he does not know this yet
posts.caption: Venus is exalted in Pisces and also near a bridge

posts.text: a pisces on the kemah boardwalk will spend forty dollars on one game trying to win a stuffed dolphin, not because i want it, but because it looked lonely and neptune said we are bringing it home
posts.caption: It was not won. It was adopted.

posts.text: my pisces sun cannot say no, which is how a quick stop at shipley for one dozen turned into four dozen, a box of kolaches for the office and a ride to the airport for the cashier's cousin
posts.caption: Boundaries dissolve. So does the glaze.

posts.text: mercury retrograde in houston is just a normal tuesday on 610. three missed exits, two u-turns under the same overpass, and a text to the group chat that says 'there in five' from somewhere on beltway 8
posts.caption: Retrograde or Tuesday, the loop does not care

posts.text: the stars say it is sweater weather. the stars do not live in houston. it is november, it is eighty-four degrees, and i am wearing the sweater in an h-e-b parking lot out of pure spite
posts.caption: Houston has two seasons and both are summer

posts.text: your rising sign is how strangers see you. your houston rising sign is your area code. 713 says 'i was here first.' 281 says 'i have a pool.' 832 says 'same phone since 2004.' 346 is still introducing itself
posts.caption: Check your chart. Then check your area code.

posts.text: nobody warns you that your saturn return comes with a toll tag. at twenty-nine you stop being a kid and start receiving monthly statements from the westpark tollway like letters from a strict uncle
posts.caption: Saturn returns, and so does the invoice
